sample_unit: responses (40 questions each to ChatGPT-5.5 and Google search)

links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, FRE) of ChatGPT-5.5 and Google outputs for caregiver education
links.effect: ChatGPT-5.5 FKGL 23.7 ± 8.5 vs. 15.4 ± 3.6 for Google (p < 0.001); FRE 17.3 ± 14.9 vs. 27.4 ± 11.7 (p < 0.001); ChatGPT responses longer (327.9 vs. 192.5 words).
links.quote: ChatGPT-5.5 generated significantly longer responses (327.9 ± 117.0 vs. 192.5 ± 85.9 words, p < 0.001), with a higher reading level (FKGL: 23.7 ± 8.5 vs. 15.4 ± 3.6, p < 0.001) and lower readability (FRE: 17.3 ± 14.9 vs. 27.4 ± 11.7, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT and Google AI Overview responses to caregiver questions regarding tetralogy of Fallot, measuring readability, accuracy, and educational quality without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
